*Researcher, Concentration of Power Evaluations.*
Hi all! I’m a MATS 7.1 alumnus. <https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=p1NIunwAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate|I previously researched> LLM steganography, CoT monitoring, and specification gaming. I’m now founding an org (backed by Coefficient Giving) to evaluate whether models are aligned to their specs and constitutions.

*Our initial focus is concentration of power (CoP).*
AI could enable <https://www.forethought.org/research/ai-enabled-coups-how-a-small-group-could-use-ai-to-seize-power|extreme> <https://www.lawfaremedia.org/article/the-unitary-artificial-executive|government> <https://law-ai.org/law-following-ai/|CoP>. Rapid AI progress, the current political climate, and the recent Anthropic vs US DoW dispute show these concerns are becoming real. Claude’s constitution and OpenAI’s model spec touch on these issues. Yet, a basic eval (<https://freesystems.substack.com/p/the-dictatorship-eval|The Dictatorship Eval>) already exposes flaws in their models’ behaviour. Models from other labs performed even worse. Anthropic imported this eval.

This project will build state-of-the-art evals that help labs improve model alignment and define desired behaviour. We will disseminate results to help alert other relevant stakeholders (policy-makers, think-tanks, the public) to the CoP issue. To facilitate this work, we will leverage:
• Expert project advisors from Anthropic (<https://www.linkedin.com/in/harvey-lederman-2b533097/|Harvey Lederman>), GovAI (<https://www.governance.ai/team/kevin-wei|Kevin Wei>), and the University of Texas (<https://www.lawfaremedia.org/contributors/kfrazier|Kevin Frazier>)
• Scenario design sessions with our network of US legal scholars
*What you will do:*
• Lead this CoP project end-to-end
• Build and run evaluations
• Organise eval scenario design sessions
• Maximise project impact by engaging with the labs, and beyond
• Scope and lead future projects (including hiring and supervising future employees)
*Who we are looking for:*
• Strong technical research skills and background
• Conceptual skills: Can think through CoP threat models to inform scenario design
• You are excited to have high autonomy, responsibility, and to help scale the org fast
    ◦ _the role could become cofounder-shaped if fit is right_
• You are excited to upskill and gain CoP context fast (we do not require a CoP background)
Bay Area location preferred. $120k-$200k salary. <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1olAYb2yDNVO0YMunJynleZREOyGxAAYO9waRvs1i77U/edit?usp=sharing|More details here>.
*<https://supreme-light-16d.notion.site/42637e7fd8ae4a78b90967ef665dafdb?pvs=105|Apply here>. <https://supreme-light-16d.notion.site/e08a01b9efc449a89aaefc3e40370236?pvs=105|$2k for successful referrals>*. Contact <mailto:robertmccarthy97@gmail.com|robertmccarthy97@gmail.com> with questions.

If you have an interest in a masters' or PhD (or a potential one), you should send me a DM sometime. Happy to talk about context and advice. I'm also generally happy to be a person to give the ~steelman~ _clear case_ in favor of non-profit and academic work over joining a big company. If you send me a message asking me for advice about what to apply for and where, one of the places (among others) that I will tell you about is Harvard. I am recruiting students, postdocs, research assistants, and fellows -- both CS and Gov-focused. There is a ton being built at Harvard and a ton to get involved with.

DM me and check out <https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScd7tk5S3E2sJr-7bIQ1Fz2xFc0IRv7HpIO5EH3mHK9F9Zp8g/viewform?usp=publish-editor|this form> if curious about any of the above.

*I'm hiring -* Come help me build a research team focused on what propensities and character traits make AI agents safe for deployment in complex, real-world settings!

I’m setting up <http://allelo.ai|Allelo> backed by Coefficient Giving, Cooperative AI Foundation, and Rethink Priorities. The starting focus is susceptibility to influence: e.g. how susceptible an agent is to persuasion. High susceptibility makes an agent exploitable and prone to collusion, but naïvely minimizing susceptibility is also likely to backfire. It is not obvious what we should aim for.

The role:

• Lead subprojects end to end, and do research yourself
• Mentor our research engineer and the junior researchers we hire next
• *Could become co-founder-shaped for the right person*
Looking for:

• Strong empirical background in something relevant to model behavior (post-training, interp, evals)
• Good at and enjoys mentoring
• Interested in the conceptual side, not only running evals
Location-flexible but ideally London-compatible, UK visa sponsorship possible. Details and form at <http://allelo.ai|allelo.ai> - apply before September 15th! You're of course also welcome to reach out to me here with any question, and recommendations for people I should speak to are extremely apprechiated.

Applications are open for a role in the California government working on frontier AI safety issues, including the implementation of SB 53, the country’s first frontier AI safety law:

	*<https://calcareers.ca.gov/CalHrPublic/Jobs/JobPosting.aspx?JobControlId=523056|Cyber Policy and Strategy Planner at Cal OES>*
You’d work with CalOES staff including <@U0490T74W79> and <@U04G7R6ECMC>, previously of METR, on critical safety incident and internal use risk reporting, as well as preparing for AI-powered cyber threats to California critical infrastructure.
*Location:* Sacramento, CA (4 days/week in-person)
	*Salary:* $103,500–$138,684
	*Position type:* Full-time, 12-month limited term (likely to become permanent)
	*Application Deadline:* September 13, 2026

Although the role has cyber in its title, cybersecurity expertise is not necessary. The role focuses much more on frontier AI policy and requires excellent written and verbal communication skills on those topics. The role has technical background requirements that can be met through different experience/education combinations, such as through a technical undergrad degree or coursework plus a year of qualifying technical experience.

Please email <mailto:implementation@secureaiproject.org|implementation@secureaiproject.org> if you’re interested in applying to the role. *If you are thinking of applying for these roles, we strongly recommend that you <https://calendly.com/skye-secureaiproject/meeting-on-implementation-roles|schedule a call> with us before you apply to hear more advice. The application process can be very confusing, and it’s easy to accidentally get autorejected by an automated application system.* Note: Secure AI Project is not affiliated with this job.
